data.narrative:
Beyond Aero, a Series A transportation startup founded by Eloa Guillotin, Hugo Tarlé, and Valentin Chomel, has raised $44M to date. The valuation landscape for frontier-mobility companies remains sparse; our peer universe comprises six private Transportation firms (Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, FleetZero, REGENT Craft) with no public comparables, limiting triangulation precision.

Given the stage and capital deployed, stage-progression methodology applies most directly. Using total raised ($44M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-round progression yields an implied valuation of $88M. Peer-median analysis proved inapplicable: while three Transportation peers exist, none satisfy filtering criteria for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or comparable valuation tier, and applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise.

This analysis supports a valuation range of $75M to $101M, with a median point of $88M. The narrow methodological foundation (single applicable approach) reflects the structural constraint of sparse, heterogeneous peer data in frontier Transportation. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to development stage, competitive positioning within the subsector, and market readiness timelines—factors not captured by stage-based mechanics alone. Additional diligence on unit economics and go-to-market traction is warranted before investment decision.
